inputs.payload: In the current workspace, first use shell to print pwd and list its current files. Create smoke_check.py defining add(a, b) as a + b. Its main block must assert add(19, 23) == 42 and print exactly OCTOMIND_SMOKE_OK. Use shell to run the script by its absolute path, explicitly print the observed process exit status, and list the workspace files again. Preserve existing unrelated files. Do not use package-installation or network tools. Finally report the script path, its actual stdout and observed exit status. Perform these checks using real tools, not hypothetical commands.
